fixture.near_formula: near_rng advances every sample; z[n]=((near_rng[n]>>16)&32767)-16384 only for 1-based capture frames 161..280, else 0
fixture.echo_formula: e[n]=0 for n<640, otherwise C99 truncation-toward-zero r[n-640]/4
fixture.mic_noise_formula: Each mic j advances its independent RNG every sample; vj[n]=((rngj[n]>>24)&127)-64

fixture.critical_semantics: Capture bytes are identical between ALL_P and PAP. PAP represents unavailable reference delivery while synthetic capture still contains the known far signal; it does not assert DAC silence or physical ADC/DAC clocks.
fixture.source_pcm_hashes: Compute and freeze exact generated little-endian S16 SHA256 before DSP output is inspected; generator formula/seed cannot be tuned after outcomes.

composition.execution_model: Finite caller-serialized owner API driver. No new pthread/liveness qualification; existing owner SPSC source is reused byte-exact.
composition.front_end: Capture-only B1 with render_channels=0 via T2-B0 and owner B1-S0. Reference SRC is separate T2-B0 state. Original SRC/FIR33/owner functions only.
composition.float_s16_boundary: Reuse R0 finite/round-nearest saturating conversion, explicit FE_TONEAREST, record clip counts independently for beam and reference; never wrap or normalize.
composition.event_order: Preflight complete downstream binding/length/alias/capacity invariants and original owner-event availability/identity. Source-owner enabled Render without token is PENDING. Consume one admitted original owner event. First ABSENT after PRESENT or first PRESENT after ABSENT causes one mono AP_DISCONTINUITY_RENDER_GAP notification with lost_frames=1 before mono render/capture calls; successive same-kind events do not notify. Push one actual converted reference only on PRESENT; process one BF mono frame; publish staged output/receipt.
composition.reset_fact: All valid mono discontinuity flags currently reset mono boundary SRC, HPF, SYNC, Activity, AEC, RES, NS, AGC and VAD. lost_frames is ignored. processed_frames is cumulative. External Capture SRC/FIR33 must not be reset by these two Render notifications.
composition.reset_accounting: Count explicit notify calls independently. Report total aec_resets, delay_jumps and automatically observed AEC resets separately; do not require total aec_resets==2 or disable trackers to force it.
composition.absence_fact: Owner EMPTY is pending, never ABSENT. ABSENT has no source PCM. Unwritten reference output is poison/sentinel and must never reach SDK push_render. SDK internal zero reference on underrun is not fabricated source PCM.
composition.atomicity: Ordinary REJECT/PENDING/FULL returns are precommit and preserve source worker tails, front-end/ref histories, complete mono state and external output/receipt. Original owner process_one is the last potentially rejecting stateful phase and already rolls back its own BF/ref transaction. Under the frozen initialized16k mono pointer, required SYNC stage, exact160 nonnull disjoint buffers and constant legal RENDER_GAP flag, ap_pipeline_notify_stream_discontinuity, push_render and process_capture all pass their only error guards and return AP_OK; their subsequent DSP bodies are non-failing. These exact guards are source-locked and checked before owner commit. An unexpected postcommit SDK status is an internal invariant breach: stop that run, preserve partial failure evidence, emit fatal COMPOSITION_INVARIANT_BREACH and refuse further use of the fixture. It is never ordinary REJECT, success, transactional no-mutation or recoverable retry. No speculative live-state snapshot/rollback is introduced.
composition.APX3_scope: No new recorder/serializer in this leaf. Existing APX3/FBS1 semantics are retained as source contract: absent file has no Render PCM; owner event/epoch/reason stays in FBS1. No 600-frame claim for bounded24 source_chunks.
composition.seam_api: Exactly two private operations: bind(fresh bridge, original owner queue/core, fresh actual mono SDK, declared disjoint arena extents) and process_one(bound bridge, int16 output, output_count, aligned work/work_bytes, receipt). No generic discontinuity/control/reset/rebind API. Source producer operations remain the original owner APIs.
composition.binding: Bind requires C4/16k, source generation/IDs/depth and original capture-only core fixed as above; all states are fresh with zero accepted/processed frames, disjoint state/work/output domains, mono full compiled mask0xff/effective mask0xfd/qualityFULL. Each process preflight checks the immutable binding and effective fixed mono configuration, all pointers/counts/extents, output/receipt alias exclusions and bounded counter room before source consumption.
composition.capture_clock_gap_boundary: This leaf accepts only continuous capture sequence and immutable source generation; original owner sequence gaps and changed generation are rejected at admission. There is no live CAPTURE_GAP/CLOCK_RESET/rebind command in the minimal seam. A fresh initializer between isolated cases does not qualify recovery or clock continuity.
composition.underrun_accounting: render_underruns can increment both for get_reference unavailable history and for note_capture staleness in one frame; it is not the owner ABSENT token count. Source absence40 is counted independently; no equality between metric underruns and missing source frames is imposed.

independent_controls.direct_reference: Separate test path outside the new composition adapter directly invokes unchanged T2-B0 capture/render and actual mono APIs. Its expected schedule is literal ALL_P or frame ranges201..240 with notify at201/241; it does not call adapter event classification/reset logic or consume adapter-produced control receipts. It receives the exact same fixture PCM, tracks actual reference ordinal independently and reads effective config independently. It is literal-control replay, not an oracle DTD/AEC feed. It may share only immutable PCM fixture data, conversion specification and original first-party DSP functions with the adapter; it must not share transition classification or control generation.
independent_controls.comparison: Per accepted frame, new adapter output PCM, public metrics fields, actual reference push count and capture-only BF output/state ledger must match this independent direct-control execution within the same build. Compare canonical fields where allocations contain different pointers; never memcmp unrelated object addresses.
independent_controls.front_end_control: ALL_P and PAP must have identical capture input, BF output and canonical capture-only source/FIR33 histories after every accepted frame. At Render notify boundaries, compare external capture state before/after notify byte-exact on the same allocation.
independent_controls.causality_control: One additional observed PAP pass changes all capture and actual-present Render samples after frame240 by integer sign inversion. All PCM/public-metric/accepted-event evidence through frame240 must exactly match original PAP; do not adapt any thresholds or inspect future samples.

observation.instrumentation: Research-only bounded RAM counters/records; each wrapper calls its exact original function once with unmodified arguments and results. File output occurs after processing.

Legacy mono BF0 and standalone time-domain RES0. Reset counts include measured automatic resets and are classified, not forced. observation.frequency_res: ap_ns_process enable_frequency_res must be1 in FULL NS+RES. Actual result.frequency_res_active must equal the source predicate enable && echo-pointer-present && mode!=SAFE && actual_far && !actual_DT. Require at least one observed active and inactive frame across each fixed trace; require an actual DT frame and both AGC allow_gain_increase branches across the fixed trace. Unreached branch is INCONCLUSIVE, never tune fixture or gates after execution.
observation.gates: The actual Activity result must feed AEC and NS unchanged; AGC allow_gain_increase must equal !(actual_far&&!actual_DT). No ground-truth near/far schedule enters DSP controls.
observation.transparency: Observed and plain binaries link the exact same original DSP static library and run same fixture/config. Final per-frame PCM and public metrics fields must match bitwise within each target/build; observer disabled/enabled must not change results.
observation.internal_precision: Read true SYNC delay samples in the read-only wrapper; public estimated_delay_ms is not precise enough for sub-ms ledger.

build.public_source: Unmodified root project through a private parent CMake add_subdirectory; actual audio_pipeline static library, not mock/reimplemented modules.
build.unity_caveat: Root CMake sets UNITY_BUILD ON. After add_subdirectory, private parent sets target audio_pipeline UNITY_BUILD OFF and INTERPROCEDURAL_OPTIMIZATION FALSE; plain and observed use this identical isolated build. CMAKE_UNITY_BUILD=OFF alone is insufficient.
settings: Private test/observer targets inherit exact actual audio_pipeline compile definitions via target-property readback so private struct layouts match; source root CMake remains unchanged.
build.identity: Pin exact source/ELF/library/generated build header/effective config/compiler versions/compile+link recipes. Cross-target bitwise equality is not asserted; each target must satisfy same semantic contract and repeat within itself.

budget.repeat_policy: No automatic repeat-until-pass; each declared repeat is evidence. Infrastructure failures retained and separately classified.
budget.PCM_retention: No full PCM uploaded by default; retain stream hashes, bounded negative witness and all failures in same existing evidence path.
budget.qualification_invocation: Counts/limits apply to each complete invocation on one immutable execution source. Local partial targets are reported only as locally executed and cannot qualify missing Arm/sanitizer modes. PR and distinct pushed-main each require their own full invocation; no result inheritance or combined partial-pass claim.

build_invocations_per_full_qualification.per_target_outputs: one unchanged-source static library and two test binaries (plain and observed); no repeated build-until-pass

budget.deadline_enforcement: One monotonic outer300s deadline for all B3 configure/build/execute/verify children in each invocation. Every child timeout is min(its declared cap, remaining outer budget, remaining existing frontend-reference job budget minus60s archival reserve). Workflow records an existing-job15min deadline before qualification work; no timeout enlargement. If insufficient time or a required tool is absent, retain BLOCKED/FAILED evidence without auto-rerun, target omission, or green claim. Local partial invocation still uses this300s outer cap and reports only chosen executed targets.
budget.observer_storage: At most600 frame records of at most384 bytes and at most8192 auxiliary bytes per active observed process, reuse per trace after outside-processing export. Compile-time sizeof checks and actual allocation totals recorded; no heap growth or I/O in frame wrapper. This instrumentation memory is separately reported and never folded into a claimed192KiB product budget.
budget.counting_definition: 19800 counts successful composed SDK process_capture frames, not source-publication attempts. Isolated negative setup contributes exactly5 successful producer publications per target (N04: one Capture; N16: two Capture plus two PRESENT Render), zero composed frames. Record these separately and destroy only the explicitly labelled isolated negative fixture; no accepted case silently drops source frames.
